lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 25-30 high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in four distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a semi-regular grid of high-contrast anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral surface, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-toned upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized distribution of high-luminance spots that transition into smaller, more compressed clusters toward the distal edge.
